page_text:
July 12, 2019 

Via Filing, Messenger, and Email  

Ms. Denise McNerney 
Merits Clerk 
Supreme Court of the United States 
One First Street, N.E. 
Washington, DC  20543 

Re:  Romag Fasteners, Inc. v. Fossil, Inc., No. 18-1233 

Dear Ms. McNerney: 

We represent petitioner and respondents in the above-captioned matter.  We write 
jointly to request extensions of time to file both parties’ merits briefs and the joint appendix 
if the case is scheduled for oral argument in January 2020.  In that event, we request the 
following deadlines: 

Brief of petitioner (and joint appendix): 
Brief of respondents: 

September 13, 2019 
November 26, 2019 

Both  parties  have  agreed  to  the  foregoing  schedule,  which  would  enable  this  case  to  be 
heard  during  the  Court’s  January  2020  sitting.    The  parties  believe  that  the  requested 
extension is appropriate given the issue presented in this case, which implicates a deep and 
long-standing split in the federal courts.   

Should you need any additional information from us, please do not hesitate to let us 

know. 

Yours sincerely, 

/s/ Lisa S. Blatt 

/s/ Jeffrey E. Dupler  

Lisa S. Blatt, Counsel for Petitioner 

     Jeffrey E. Dupler, Counsel for Respondents
